cwe_content.cwe: CWE-79,Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

candidate.Reason: When htmlTagsRenderingEnabled=true, HTML_RENDERER_LOOSE is used with HtmlRenderer.ESCAPE_HTML=false, allowing raw HTML output. Although Jsoup.clean() is applied, the SAFE_HTML_TAGS whitelist may not be sufficient to prevent all XSS vectors if the whitelist is incomplete or bypassable.

Mustache compiler is explicitly configured with escapeHTML(false), disabling HTML escaping. This allows raw HTML injection from template variables, making it vulnerable to XSS if user-controlled data is passed to the template context.
